property_summary: After any valid 10-ether call, C's balance is drained only when block.number % 15 == 0; on any other block the contract retains its ether, whereas the mutant drains it on every block, so for any block not divisible by 15 the reference keeps a positive balance while the mutant leaves it at zero.
change_summary: Change the payout condition to always true so every valid call triggers the transfer.
